nffe01.title: The friend who went quiet
nffe01.caption: When a friend goes quiet, it is easy to assume it is about you. Often it isn't. Send a check-in with no homework attached: thinking of you, no need to reply.

nffe02.title: Check-in, not a quiz
nffe02.caption: Six questions in a row can feel like a test, even when they come from love. Ask one soft question, then let the quiet do some of the work. Save this for the next time you're worried about a friend.

nffe03.title: December is hard for some friends
nffe03.caption: Not everyone loves this month, especially in a year when someone is missing. You don't have to fix it. Ask if they want company or quiet, and make room for both.

nffe04.title: The plan you can say no to
nffe04.caption: The kindest invites come with an easy way out. Pyjamas welcome, leave whenever, no is totally fine. When saying no is easy, saying yes gets a little easier too.

nffe05.title: The cancelled-plans friend
nffe05.caption: Third cancellation and the scorecard is already drafted. Skip it. Say how it felt once, kindly, then ask what's going on with them. Sometimes the answer is just: I'm overbooked.

nffe06.title: Long-distance friends
nffe06.caption: Different cities, different clocks, a lot of missed calls. A small ritual beats a perfect plan: one time, every week, kept. Who would you set a standing call with?
